slot_scores.name: missing_profit_maximization_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to maximize total weekly profit, or is it to find any feasible production plan that simply meets the minimum profit of 3000 yuan?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked what the objective should be, distinguishing profit maximization from mere feasibility, and the user confirmed profit maximization.

slot_scores.name: missing_idle_time_minimization_objective
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about minimizing idle time, unused capacity, or any secondary/multi-objective component weighted by process hourly costs. The generic question about additional requirements does not specifically target idle time.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Only weekly profit maximization matters, and idle-time minimization for manufacturing, assembly, and inspection is not part of the objective.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked whether idle time or unused process capacity should also be minimized with cost-proportional weights, and later modeled only profit maximization.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 objective slot H1 was resolved, but P1 slot H2 about idle-time minimization was never asked or confirmed before the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent correctly resolved the core profit-maximization objective and several other details, but it failed to ask about the secondary idle-time minimization objective and silently modeled the problem as single-objective profit maximization.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
